lines.text: Paul says that by faith we eagerly await through the Spirit the hope of glory, and that in Christ Jesus what matters is faith expressing itself through love (Galatians 5:5-6).

Paul says they were called to freedom, so serve one another in love, because the entire law is fulfilled in a single decree, which is to remember the Sabbath day, and he warns them to watch out, or they will be consumed by one another if they keep on biting and devouring one another (Galatians 5:13-15).

problems.problem: Its true detail "by faith" isn't in the Prep cards, so the walkthrough didn't teach it.
"love your enemies" and "Love your neighbor as yourself" aren't the same kind of thing (one is a name, one isn't).
